scope: Theorem 1.2 (Intrinsic spherical scaling; companion consequence) of the manuscript “Canonical conformal limits of subcritical FK planar maps” (preprints/Canonical-conformal-limits-of-subcritical-FK-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e7dab39caf778176), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 4-5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the finite law of Theo- rem 2.1 and γ in (1.1), there is a deterministic sequence an > 0 with an → 0 such that (V (Mn), andn) =⇒ (S, Dh) 4 in the Gromov–Hausdorff topology on compact metric spaces up to isometry, through all positive integers. The limit is the ordinary unit-area γ-LQG sphere of Duplantier et al. [16, Defini- tion 4.21(ii)], disintegrated at total quantum area one, with its marked points forgotten and with the fixed intrinsic metric normalization. The root and FK decoration are forgotten in this convergence.
